name: Seacliff
label: Below market value
paymentPlan: 20% down at sales launch; 30% during construction; 50% on handover
overview: Seacliff by Imtiaz is a contemporary waterfront residential development rising along the shores of Dubai Islands, one of the emirate's most exciting and rapidly evolving coastal destinations. Developed by Imtiaz Developments, the project is designed for those who want more than just a home it is a lifestyle defined by open sea views, thoughtful architecture, and a genuine sense of community. With freehold ownership available and a starting price from AED 2 million, Seacliff presents a compelling opportunity for both end-users and investors looking to secure a foothold in a location that continues to grow in significance across Dubai's residential landscape.
